privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Presk collects, uses and protects your data.
privacy.s1b1: We collect the information you provide when you create an account, including your name, email address and organization details.
privacy.s1b2: We also collect usage data — such as the features you interact with — to operate, secure and improve the service.
privacy.s2b1: We use your information to provide the service, authenticate users, respond to support requests and send product updates you have opted into.
privacy.s2b2: We never sell your personal data.
privacy.s3b1: We retain personal data for as long as your account is active. When you delete your account, we remove or anonymize your data within 30 days, except where we are required to retain it by law.
privacy.s4b1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, export or delete your personal data. Contact privacy@presk.app to exercise these rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The agreement that governs your use of Presk.
terms.s1b1: By accessing or using Presk, you agree to be bound by these terms. If you use the service on behalf of an organization, you represent that you have authority to bind that organization.
terms.s2b1: You agree not to misuse the service, including by attempting to access it by any means other than the interfaces we provide, or by using it to store or share unlawful content.
terms.s3b1: Paid plans renew automatically unless cancelled. Fees are non-refundable except where required by law. You are responsible for any taxes associated with your subscription.
terms.s4b1: You may stop using the service at any time. We may suspend or terminate access if you violate these terms or if required to protect the service or other users.

security.title: Security
security.description: How Presk protects your workspace and data.
security.s1b1: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS and at rest using industry-standard encryption. Credentials are hashed, never stored in plain text.
security.s1b2: We rotate keys regularly and follow least-privilege access for internal systems.
security.s2b1: Organizations include role-based access control with owner, admin, member and viewer roles. File permissions can be set per person and per file.
security.s2b2: Enterprise plans add SSO, SCIM provisioning and detailed audit logging.
security.s3b1: We perform regular backups and monitor for anomalies. If you believe you have found a vulnerability, contact security@presk.app.
security.s3b2: We disclose incidents promptly and transparently to affected organizations.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: How Presk uses cookies and similar technologies.
cookies.s1b1: We use cookies to keep you signed in, remember your preferences such as language and theme, and understand how the product is used so we can improve it.
cookies.s2b1: Essential cookies are required for the service to work. Preference cookies remember settings you choose. Analytics cookies help us measure usage in aggregate.
cookies.s2b2: We do not use cookies to sell your data or to show third-party advertising.
cookies.s3b1: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may prevent parts of the service from working.
